FortAD parser and forward commands return products whose strict generated sources contain invalid deferred-shape/declaration interfaces; reverse also refuses automatic dependent inference and, with explicit R, reaches the per-iteration FD storage boundary. The independent flux/storage oracle passes without a derivative-support claim.
